title: Realistic Gunpowder Craft
description: Takes gunpowder craft to another level with the new sulfur blocks (adds new Potassium Nitrate and Saltpeter Base items)
body:
## Realistic Gunpowder Craft ### Takes gunpowder craft to another level with the new sulfur blocks andesite + rotten flesh + wheat = saltpeter base
saltpeter base in furnace = potassium nitrate
5x potassium nitrate + sulfur + charcoal = 7x gunpowder


## Why is the recipe so strange? In real life, the gunpowder is made up of 75% potassium nitrate, 15% charcoal and 10% sulfur.
Charcoal and sulfur are already in minecraft, so I tried implementing potassium nitrate.
According to Wikipedia, in medieval times people got potassium nitrate [by mixing manure with either mortar or wood ashes, common earth and organic materials such as straw to give porosity to a compost pile](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Potassium_nitrate) and also mixed with limestone (nearest - andesite. I did not find the mention of limestone in English wiki, but there is a [Russian page that says about it](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Нитрат_калия)).
Btw, this is my first published mod and it was made without anything like MCCreator, just using the fabric documentation :)
